item.description: SCOTT COUNTY, Mo. (KBSI) – A case ran cold is being relooked at today, as city officials have been out in Scott County near County Road 305, digging for the possible remains of Cheryl Ann Scherer. 19-year-old Cheryl Ann Scherer vanished from the Scott City Rhodes gas station on April 17th in 1979, her family and local investigators have been working together searching for the Scott County teen ever since.
